nodes.label: Frigate AI Policy
nodes.rationale: Written because unreviewed AI output costs unpaid maintainers real review time and gives less signal than a few honest sentences; the policy targets what is posted, not which tools were used.

nodes.label: Human In The Loop Requirement
nodes.source_location: ## A person has to be in the loop
nodes.rationale: Every issue, discussion, comment and PR must be read and submitted by a person. Bots/agents posting autonomously are prohibited because merged code creates a permanent maintenance burden that requires someone who understands it; code nobody understands is a liability.

nodes.label: AI Usage Disclosure Requirement
nodes.rationale: Disclosure is explicitly non-disqualifying: maintainers prefer honest disclosure over later discovery because trust matters more than method. Scrutiny scales inversely with a contributor's track record rather than through a formal exemption.

nodes.label: AI Policy Enforcement and Misjudgment Recourse
nodes.rationale: Maintainers acknowledge no reliable AI detection exists; calls are subjective and fast because volume is real. A contributor's word that they wrote it themselves is accepted, preferring occasional reopening over treating everyone as a suspect.
